stages.title: Foundation ICF
stages.desc: Nudura ICF foundation walls, two courses below the ground-floor level: 6in XR35 external walls, 6in Standard party and stair-enclosure walls.

stages.title: Ground-floor slab
stages.desc: The ground-floor slab build-up inside the foundation walls, indicative pending the engineer's design.

stages.title: Ground-floor ICF, partitions and porch steel
stages.desc: Ground-floor walls, six courses to 2,743 mm, with the window and door openings, and the porch steel (UKB 356x171x45, TLS proposed) pocketed into the stair walls and the party wall. Ground-floor timber stud partitions (38x89 C16).

stages.title: First floor and stairs
stages.desc: 253 mm metal-web joists top-hung on cut-down ledgers fixed to the ICF with Strong-Tie connectors, 22 mm Egger Protect deck, and the timber quarter-turn stairs.

stages.title: First-floor ICF and partitions
stages.desc: First-floor walls to the eaves at 5,250 mm, the gables to the roof line and the party wall carried up to the rafters. First-floor timber stud partitions (38x89 C16).

stages.title: Roof structure
stages.desc: Fink trussed rafters at 600 centres with gable ladders, and the mono-pitch porch trusses hung on the porch steel.

stages.title: Windows, doors and partition linings
stages.desc: UPVC windows and doors set behind the 25 mm head and jamb overfly, the bathroom pattress ply and the partition noggins.
